name: dsh-mac-tools
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a local macOS toolbox panel — QQ-style screenshot capture with crop and annotations, a calculator, phone transfer (QR-code LAN page for text/files/images), clipboard and system information
author: long0521

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/capture.js && node --check src/windows.js && node --check src/calc.js && node --check src/system.js && node --check src/store.js && node --check src/ops.js && node --check src/route.js && node --check src/visibility.js && node --check src/hotkey.js && node --check src/pin.js && node --check src/history.js && node --check src/selection.js && node --check src/transfer.js && node --check src/transfer-qr.js && node --check src/transfer-page.js && node --check client/index.js && node --test test/

plugin.title: Mac Tools
plugin.summary: A local macOS toolbox panel: QQ-style screenshot capture with crop and annotations, a calculator, phone transfer (scan a QR code to exchange text, files and photos with a phone on the same Wi-Fi), clipboard and system information. Panel-only; it registers no agent tools.
